item.title: New agent framework matches human-engineered AI systems — and adds zero inference cost to deploy
item.description: Agents built on top of today's models often break with simple changes — a new library, a workflow modification — and require a human engineer to fix it. item.title: The 'last-mile' data problem is stalling enterprise agentic AI — 'golden pipelines' aim to fix it
item.description: Traditional ETL tools like dbt or Fivetran prepare data for reporting: structured analytics and dashboards with stable schemas. AI applications need something different: preparing messy, evolving operational data for model inference in real-time. item.title: Rapidata emerges to shorten AI model development cycles from months to days with near real-time RLHF
item.description: Despite growing chatter about a future when much human work is automated by AI, one of the ironies of this current tech boom is how stubbornly reliant on human beings it remains, specifically the process of training AI models using reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF).
